title: Cron jobs
intro: Each job runs one command line as the user {{user}} in its home directory, with lower priority than the site. A “%” is passed to the shell as written, unlike in a crontab.
siteDisabled: The site is disabled: its cron jobs do not run until it is enabled.
statusUnknown: Last and next runs are not known right now: the server did not answer.
max: A site has at most {{max}} cron jobs.
started: The cron job started. Its result shows up under “Last run”.
pausedDone: Cron job paused. It runs only when started by hand.
showRun: Show the output of this run
hideRun: Hide the output of this run

output.title: Output of the last run
output.notRan: No output known: the job has not run since the server started or since it was last changed.
output.footer: Standard output and errors of the job, at most the last 200 lines per run, as long as the system journal keeps them.

form.scheduleHint: Five cron fields (minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week), like */15 * * * *, or @hourly, @daily, @weekly, @monthly.
form.runs: Runs {{words}}, in the server's time zone.
form.commandHint: One line, run by the shell. For example: php htdocs/wp-cron.php
form.timeLimitHint: A run that takes longer is stopped. 1 to {{max}}.
form.priorityHint: 0 to 19; higher numbers leave more CPU to the site.
form.paused: Paused: runs only when started by hand

problems.tooLong: The schedule is longer than 200 characters.
problems.reboot: @reboot is not supported. Use a time, like @daily.
problems.keyword: "{{value}}" is not a known keyword. Use @hourly, @daily, @weekly, @monthly or @yearly.
problems.fiveFields: Use five fields (minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week), like */5 * * * *, or a keyword like @daily.
problems.commandLong: The command is longer than {{max}} bytes.
problems.oneLine: Write the command on one line.
problems.timeout: The time limit must be whole minutes from 1 to {{max}}.
problems.nice: The priority must be a whole number from 0 to 19.

describe.monthly: on the 1st of every month at 00:00

last.timeout: Stopped {{when}}: it ran longer than its time limit

errors.cron_unavailable: Cron jobs are not available on this panel.
errors.too_many_cron_jobs: A site has at most {{max}} cron jobs. Delete one first.
errors.agent_precondition: The site is disabled. Enable it to run its cron jobs.
errors.site_busy: The site is not active right now. Reload the page in a moment.
errors.forbidden: Only administrators can manage cron jobs.
errors.gone: This cron job does not exist any more. Reload the page.
errors.run_not_found: This run is no longer among the last runs. Choose another one.

runs.title: Last runs
runs.none: The system journal has no runs of this job.
